manifest.description: Tell it how you feel, or name a song that moved you. A DJ agent finds songs with the same feeling and plays them on YouTube or bilibili in Kiro Crew's browser. Like or skip, and the next picks follow.
manifest.highlight_1: Say how you feel, or name a song that moved you — it finds more with the same feeling
manifest.highlight_2: Every pick says why it fits the mood
manifest.highlight_3: Songs play in Kiro Crew's browser, with its sound; the page has play, pause and volume
manifest.highlight_4: The agent opens only bilibili and YouTube search and video pages, and never signs in, comments, likes or pays
manifest.highlight_5: Like or skip a song, and the next picks use it
manifest.highlight_6: The background and motion follow the mood, in light and dark
manifest.use_case_1: Find and play songs that match how you feel right now, and keep a history of the moments that moved you.
manifest.configuration_1: Needs a Kiro Crew with app browser sites (newer than v0.13.0-rc.3). Approve the music sites once, on the app's page in Kiro Crew.

page.title: Mood Music
page.mood_label: How do you feel, or which song moved you?
page.empty_body: Say how you feel, or pick a mood above.
page.moments_empty_body: Each mood you share is kept here, with the songs it brought.
page.error_unreadable: Couldn't read your buddy's answer. Try again.
page.dropped: Songs left out because their link cannot play: {{count}}
page.error_old_host: This Kiro Crew is too old to open your buddy's hidden chat. Update Kiro Crew, then open this page again.
page.error_hidden_refused: Kiro Crew would not open your buddy's hidden chat. Check that Mood Music is turned on and trusted, on the app's page.

memory.add_label: Tell your buddy something to remember
memory.add_placeholder: e.g. not too loud / I like Cantonese / jazz on rainy days
memory.empty_body: Songs you like, skip or already know show up here, with anything you add.
memory.clear_confirm: Remove {{count}} out-of-date items? What you wrote yourself stays.
memory.error_full: Memory is full of your own items. Delete one first.

chat.subtitle: Your music buddy: say how you feel, hear good songs you have not heard yet
chat.hello: Hi, I'm your music buddy. Tell me how you feel, or a song that moved you.
chat.placeholder: How do you feel, or a song that moved you…
chat.status_searching: Your buddy is searching… ({{count}} so far)
chat.status_reading: Your buddy is reading reviews and lists… ({{count}} pages)
chat.status_checking: Your buddy is checking each song plays…
chat.approval_host: Your buddy wants to open a web page: {{host}}
chat.approval_tool: Your buddy needs your OK to use a tool
chat.grant_title: First let your buddy ask for your OK here
chat.grant_not_declared: This version of the app cannot ask here. Allow it in the full chat for now, or update the app.
chat.grant_consent: On the app's page, click "Enable and allow chat control", then come back.
chat.grant_disabled: The app is turned off. On its page, click "Enable".
chat.grant_unavailable: This cannot be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
chat.all_dropped: None of the {{count}} songs found this time could play. Try another direction?
chat.stay_only: Just stay in this feeling today
chat.status_playing: Your buddy is opening the song in Kiro Crew's browser…

card.unverified_hint: YouTube or bilibili could not be asked whether this video exists, so it may not play.

browser.status_opening: Your buddy is opening it in Kiro Crew's browser…
browser.status_idle: Nothing plays yet. "Find and play" asks your buddy to open this song in Kiro Crew's browser.
browser.status_in_control: You are using the browser tab. The buttons wait until you hand it back.
browser.status_no_media: The browser tab has no player yet.
browser.continuous_note: Continuous play works only while this page is open. Close it, and the music stops when the current song ends.
browser.not_played: Your buddy could not play it this time: {{reason}}
browser.unready_title: Songs cannot play in Kiro Crew's browser yet
browser.unready_old_host: This Kiro Crew is too old. Update Kiro Crew to a version with app browser sites (KiroCrew#38333, newer than v0.13.0-rc.3), then open this page again.
browser.unready_not_approved: First approve the music sites for Mood Music. You approve them once, on the app's page.
browser.unready_browse_off: Kiro Crew's browser is turned off by a policy on this computer.

view.title: Kiro Crew's browser
view.idle: Your buddy is not using the browser right now.
view.old_host: This Kiro Crew cannot show its browser here yet. Update Kiro Crew to watch your buddy pick songs.
